exceptions.bounded_evidence: All six rated sources are easy. The two unrated two-fragment blanks have missing correct references and solutions. Every source uses exactly orientation reversal and coordinate selection. Archived moderate/hard representations only change denominator size or decimal notation (and denominator clearing in experimental blanks), without a source-backed moderate/hard workload. Those research samples are not admitted as supported bands. This is a package capability boundary, not a global impossibility claim.
exceptions.reopen: New rated or validated same-KP instructional evidence

finite_limits.definition: Required axis x or y, integer required coordinate -12..12; incidental c, unused coordinate, seed, layout, scalar-equivalent equation, bank and option order do not add tasks.
finite_limits.sampling_attempt_limit: 200 * count; failure returns an explicit finite-limit rather than duplicated tasks

operational_interface: generate and batch support easy only; experimental_generate retains previous research cases for audit, never operational admission
